summary: This BEA web page is the data-download index for Input-Output Accounts Data. It lists downloadable supply, use, import, make, requirements and market-share tables for 2017-2022 (in 15, 17, 71 or 73 industry/commodity groupings) and detailed 2017 tables (402 industries or commodities), plus older 1947-1996 summary tables. It also notes the 2023 comprehensive update, domestic requirements tables first released Feb. 17, 2017, and a contact email for questions.
one_line: BEA's index page of downloadable input-output accounts tables covering supply, use, make, import and requirements data for 1947 through 2022.
key_facts: The Bureau of Economic Analysis states that selected annual Industry Economic Account statistics for 2017 through 2022 reflect the 2023 comprehensive update of the National Economic Accounts.
Data prior to 2017 will be forthcoming, according to the page's note.
Supply Tables show domestic supply of commodities by industry and are available for 2017-2022 in 15 and 71 industry groupings, and for 2017 in 402 industries.
Use Tables show use of commodities by industry and are available for 2017-2022 in 15 and 71 industry groupings, and for 2017 in 402 industries.
Domestic requirements tables were first released by BEA on Feb. 17, 2017.
The Survey of Current Business article 'Introducing Domestic Requirements Tables for 1997-2015' provides additional details on domestic requirements statistics.
Total requirements tables show total inputs required, directly and indirectly, to deliver one dollar of output to final users.
Domestic requirements tables show domestic inputs required, directly and indirectly, to deliver one dollar of output to final users.
Make and use tables for 1947-1962 and 1963-1996 are available as summary files with 46 and 65 industries respectively.
Make Tables after redefinitions show production of commodities by industry after redefinition of secondary production.
The after redefinition tables are used as inputs into the derivation of the total requirements and domestic requirements matrices.
Archived industry data are available through BEA's data archives.
Questions about Input-Output data can be sent to industryeconomicaccounts@bea.gov.
The page was last modified on 2/1/24.
